svg.title: Time per question by number of orders
svg.desc: Median warm latency of the aggregate questions at four table sizes, with the log-log slope of each system.
svg.text: Time per question from 25,000 to 10,000,000 orders
Median warm milliseconds, logarithmic axes. The number after a system is the log-log slope of its line: 1.00 is time proportional
to the rows, 0 is flat. pg_duckdb was measured at 1M and 10M only.
